validity.recommendation: Aug 2026 EIA shows conflicting tabular specs vs description; source clarification
validity.researcher_notes: Traverse Pipeline exists and is real: confirmed by multiple EIA releases and official website. Jan 2026 EIA tabular shows 160 mi, 36 in, 1750 MMcf/d matching sheet values. Aug 2026 EIA tabular shows 152 mi, 42 in, 2400 MMcf/d; however, Aug 2026 description text explicitly states '160-mile 36-inch... up to 1.75 Bcf/d', matching Jan 2026 and sheet values. The tabular discrepancy in Aug 2026 is likely a data entry error or scope change not reflected in the description. Status upgraded from 'Approved' (Jan 2026) to 'Construction' (May/Aug 2026 EIA). [ORCHESTRATOR AUDIT 2026-09-15] Tier arithmetic corrected (tier 'high' -> 'medium'; independent True -> False): this record's evidence resolves to 1 distinct publisher(s) (eia.gov), and rule 4 counts publishers, not URLs — every EIA release is ONE origin, as are multiple filings by one filer or multiple notices in one docket. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
